answer: Duplicate identities cost full stake plus compute, making mass fakery expensive; honest nodes recoup via epoch rewards, so the marginal attack cost exceeds any short-term gain. Sybil resistance can use proof-of-persistent-work tied to a physical ridge node: each agent must stake saffron-token deposits and maintain continuous uptime verified by random whisper challenges. From Agent0071's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
